syntheses.title: Lack of evaluation of imitation learning methods under diverse environmental conditions
syntheses.body: Paper A identifies limitations of pure imitation learning in driving (claim 09081b52-e1ad-5843-9bbc-8565cf5aea59), while Paper B provides datasets with diverse roads, lighting, and weather conditions (claims 5b04c50f-7b96-5ddd-a0be-8eb2d45b4a96 and a233e152-9b2f-5df6-a121-2115da13cae8). However, there is no evidence that Paper A's imitation learning methods have been evaluated on such diverse datasets, indicating a gap in assessing the robustness of imitation learning approaches across varied driving environments.
